# Ocean Health Multi-Indicator Time Series (1990–2024)

## Overview
Four global ocean health indicators tracked biennially from 1990 to 2014 and annually from 2015 to 2024, each with distinct units and trend directions, designed to illustrate the compound stress on marine ecosystems.

## Data Source

### sea_surface_temperature_anomaly
- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `anomaly_c` (float, °C relative to 1961–1990 baseline)
- **Range**: 0.04 to 0.91 °C
- **Trend**: Generally increasing with interannual variability; sharp rise post-2022

### ocean_ph
- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `ph` (float, dimensionless pH scale)
- **Range**: 8.034 to 8.110
- **Trend**: Steady decline (increasing acidity); narrow numerical range requiring fine-scale axis

### coral_cover
- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `cover_pct` (float, percentage of reef area)
- **Range**: 11.5% to 33.5%
- **Trend**: Long-term decline with a notable drop during the 1998 bleaching event and accelerating loss after 2015

### ocean_plastic_pollution
- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `plastic_mmt` (float, million metric tons cumulative)
- **Range**: 25 to 255 million metric tons
- **Trend**: Near-exponential growth throughout the period

## Data Notes
- Temperature anomalies are modeled global means; regional values vary significantly.
- Ocean pH values represent open-ocean surface averages; coastal and deep-water pH differ.
- Coral cover estimates are synthesized from GCRMN-style monitoring and carry ±2–4% uncertainty.
- Plastic pollution figures are cumulative stock estimates and include modeled seafloor accumulation, which is the largest and most uncertain component.

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Extract series
sst = data['sea_surface_temperature_anomaly']['data']
ph = data['ocean_ph']['data']
coral = data['coral_cover']['data']
plastic = data['ocean_plastic_pollution']['data']

sst_years = [d['year'] for d in sst]
sst_vals = [d['anomaly_c'] for d in sst]

ph_years = [d['year'] for d in ph]
ph_vals = [d['ph'] for d in ph]

coral_years = [d['year'] for d in coral]
coral_vals = [d['cover_pct'] for d in coral]

plastic_years = [d['year'] for d in plastic]
plastic_vals = [d['plastic_mmt'] for d in plastic]

# Color palette - scientific, colorblind-friendly
colors = {
    'sst': '#c0392b',
    'ph': '#2471a3',
    'coral': '#1e8449',
    'plastic': '#b9770e'
}

# Set up figure with 4 stacked subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, 1, figsize=(13, 14), sharex=True)
fig.subplots_adjust(hspace=0.18, top=0.92, bottom=0.06, left=0.12, right=0.92)

# Common styling
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

# Highlight zones
for ax in axes:
    ax.axvspan(2015, 2024.5, alpha=0.07, color='#e74c3c', zorder=0)
    ax.axvline(x=1998, color='#7f8c8d', linewidth=0.7, linestyle=':', alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
    ax.set_xlim(1989, 2025)
    ax.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.25, linewidth=0.5)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=10)

# ---- SST Anomaly ----
ax0 = axes[0]
ax0.plot(sst_years, sst_vals, color=colors['sst'], linewidth=2.2, linestyle='-',
         marker='o', markersize=4.5, markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2,
         markeredgecolor=colors['sst'], zorder=3)
ax0.set_ylabel('Temperature Anomaly (°C)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
               color=colors['sst'], labelpad=8)
ax0.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.0)
ax0.yaxis.set_major_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(0.2))
ax0.yaxis.set_minor_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(0.1))

# Annotate sharp recent rise
ax0.annotate('', xy=(2024, 0.91), xytext=(2021, 0.61),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=colors['sst'], lw=1.5, ls='--'))
ax0.text(2022.5, 0.82, '+0.30 °C\nin 3 years', fontsize=8.5, color=colors['sst'],
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=colors['sst'],
                   alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.6))

# Label for indicator
ax0.text(0.01, 0.92, 'Sea Surface Temperature Anomaly', transform=ax0.transAxes,
         fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', color=colors['sst'], va='top',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=colors['sst'],
                   alpha=0.9, linewidth=0.8))

# ---- Ocean pH ----
ax1 = axes[1]
ax1.plot(ph_years, ph_vals, color=colors['ph'], linewidth=2.2, linestyle='--',
         marker='s', markersize=4.5, markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2,
         markeredgecolor=colors['ph'], zorder=3)
ax1.set_ylabel('Ocean pH', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
               color=colors['ph'], labelpad=8)
ax1.set_ylim(8.025, 8.120)
ax1.yaxis.set_major_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(0.02))
ax1.yaxis.set_minor_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(0.01))
ax1.invert_yaxis()  # Lower pH (more acidic) = worse, so invert to align "bad" downward visually

# Annotate pH decline
ax1.annotate('', xy=(2024, 8.034), xytext=(1990, 8.110),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=colors['ph'], lw=1.3, ls='--'))
ax1.text(2007, 8.065, '−0.076 pH units\n(≈26% more acidic)', fontsize=8.5,
         color=colors['ph'], ha='center', va='center', fontstyle='italic',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=colors['ph'],
                   alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.6))

ax1.text(0.01, 0.92, 'Ocean pH  (acidification ↑)', transform=ax1.transAxes,
         fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', color=colors['ph'], va='top',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=colors['ph'],
                   alpha=0.9, linewidth=0.8))

# ---- Coral Cover ----
ax2 = axes[2]
ax2.plot(coral_years, coral_vals, color=colors['coral'], linewidth=2.2, linestyle='-',
         marker='D', markersize=4.5, markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2,
         markeredgecolor=colors['coral'], zorder=3)
ax2.set_ylabel('Coral Cover (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
               color=colors['coral'], labelpad=8)
ax2.set_ylim(8, 36)
ax2.yaxis.set_major_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(5))
ax2.yaxis.set_minor_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(2.5))

# Shade the accelerating decline post-2015
ax2.fill_between(coral_years, 8, coral_vals, where=[y >= 2015 for y in coral_years],
                 alpha=0.12, color=colors['coral'], zorder=2)
# Annotate 1998 bleaching
ax2.annotate('1998 mass\nbleaching', xy=(1998, 27.2), xytext=(2001.5, 31),

             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=colors['coral'], lw=1.2),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=colors['coral'],
                       alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.6))
# Annotate accelerating decline
ax2.annotate('', xy=(2024, 11.5), xytext=(2015, 22.6),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=colors['coral'], lw=1.5, ls='--'))
ax2.text(2021, 19, '−49% since 2015\n(accelerating)', fontsize=8.5, color=colors['coral'],
         ha='center', va='center', fontstyle='italic',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=colors['coral'],
                   alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.6))

ax2.text(0.01, 0.92, 'Hard Coral Cover', transform=ax2.transAxes,
         fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', color=colors['coral'], va='top',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=colors['coral'],
                   alpha=0.9, linewidth=0.8))

# ---- Plastic Pollution ----
ax3 = axes[3]
ax3.plot(plastic_years, plastic_vals, color=colors['plastic'], linewidth=2.2, linestyle='-.',
         marker='^', markersize=4.5, markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2,
         markeredgecolor=colors['plastic'], zorder=3)
ax3.set_ylabel('Cumulative Plastic (Mmt)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
               color=colors['plastic'], labelpad=8)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 280)
ax3.yaxis.set_major_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(50))
ax3.yaxis.set_minor_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(25))

# Add exponential reference curve
from numpy import exp, linspace
x_ref = linspace(1990, 2024, 200)
y_start, y_end = 25, 255
k = np.log(y_end / y_start) / (2024 - 1990)
y_ref = y_start * np.exp(k * (x_ref - 1990))
ax3.plot(x_ref, y_ref, color=colors['plastic'], linewidth=1.0, linestyle=':',
         alpha=0.45, zorder=2)
ax3.text(2003, 170, 'exponential\nreference', fontsize=8, color=colors['plastic'],
         ha='center', va='center', fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.7)

# Annotate 10x growth
ax3.annotate('10× growth\n(25 → 255 Mmt)', xy=(2024, 255), xytext=(2018, 160),
             fontsize=8.5, color=colors['plastic'], ha='center', fontstyle='italic',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=colors['plastic'], lw=1.2),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=colors['plastic'],
                       alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.6))

ax3.text(0.01, 0.92, 'Ocean Plastic Pollution (cumulative)', transform=ax3.transAxes,
         fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', color=colors['plastic'], va='top',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=colors['plastic'],
                   alpha=0.9, linewidth=0.8))

# ---- Shared x-axis ----
ax3.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', labelpad=6)
ax3.xaxis.set_major_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(5))
ax3.xaxis.set_minor_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(1))
ax3.tick_params(labelbottom=True)

# Add year labels to all subplots
for ax in axes:
    ax.tick_params(labelbottom=True)

# Shade label for post-2015 zone at top
axes[0].text(2019.5, 0.97, 'Post-2015\nacceleration zone', fontsize=8,
             color='#c0392b', ha='center', va='top', fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.7,
             transform=axes[0].get_xaxis_transform())

# 1998 event label at bottom
axes[3].text(1998, -22, '1998 El Niño', fontsize=8, color='#7f8c8d',
             ha='center', va='top', fontstyle='italic')

# Title
fig.suptitle('Multi-Indicator Ocean Health Deterioration, 1990–2024',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.97, color='#2c3e50')
fig.text(0.5, 0.945,
         'Four independent indicators reveal compounding marine ecosystem stress  ·  '
         'Red shading = post-2015 acceleration period  ·  Dotted line = 1998 El Niño',
         ha='center', fontsize=9.5, color='#5d6d7e', fontstyle='italic')

# Save
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.3)
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
